title: A Three-Manifold Without Conjugate Points and Without a Nonpositively Curved Metric
summary: We construct a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold that admits a smooth Riemannian metric without conjugate points but admits no smooth Riemannian metric of nonpositive sectional curvature.
family_title: A three-manifold without conjugate points or nonpositive curvature

review.reason: Constructs a closed 3-manifold with no conjugate points but no nonpositively curved metric.
